papers.title: A novel PAAND-like MEFV variant in cis with an FMF mutation drives severe neonatal autoinflammation.
papers.abstract: A fatal neonatal autoinflammatory disease is reported, associated with two cis MEFV variants: the FMF-associated p.V726A and the novel de novo PAAND-like p.G211R. Functional studies confirmed constitutive pyrin inflammasome activation, resulting in an exceptionally severe, treatment-refractory phenotype.
